thread:
jas: From PM-2910 follow-ups 1: we're still seeing the "tail" latency pattern under medium-long bursts. Need concrete, testable follow-ups that prevent regressions and are runnable in CI / chaos drills. Proposing three parallel deliverables.

ana: what are you thinking for the deliverables?

jas: 1) incident-regression prompt suite (INF-4312) 120-200 prompts sampled from real incident traces, split into 'latency-only' and 'semantic' sets. 2) synthetic load + KV-eviction drill (INF-4313) to reproduce the tail and validate fallback. 3) fallback-resilience harness (INF-4314) that toggles routing tables and asserts no elevated error-rate.

kevin: I can take the harness (INF-4314). I'll implement a small runner that can flip routing rules and assert error-rate < 0.5% and p95 within 1.5x baseline. Will add `ci/evals/incident-resilience` job. ETA 10 business days.

ana: happy to assemble the prompt suite (INF-4312). I'll label each prompt with category + expected check (regex or prefix for semantic, none for latency-only). Plan: pull samples from s3://redwood-prod/incident-dumps and the case DB. Hope to have a draft in 4 days.

todd: I'll lead INF-4313. Draft plan: stage-only drill that runs a 15m ramp (50->800 qps), with controlled KV eviction (restart cache pods on 30% of hosts) at 8m mark. Validation: no >3x error-rate spike, p95 < 400ms. I'll put prototype scripts in infra/tests/load/examples and schedule the first drill in ~2 weeks.

mira: Good. Please attach repro steps and a short runbook snippet to each ticket so anyone can reproduce. Also add a test-data artifact to the prompt ticket and a small synthetic corpus for the load job.

kevin: For the harness I want a table of fallback chains we can mock. Can ops export the routing map used in incidents?

jas: I'll export the routing snapshot that corresponds to PM-2910 and attach to INF-4314.

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4312 by ana 120-200 prompt regression set (incident-tail reproduction)

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4313 by todd 15m stage load + KV eviction drill (reproduce tail)

ops-bot: New issue created: INF-4314 by kevin 
fallback-resilience harness + CI integration

ana: quick question on assertions: for latency-only prompts we'll avoid token equality checks. Use prefix checks or length ranges. For semantic regressions we can use BLEU-ish or matcher rules.

kevin: agreed. harness will accept validators per-prompt and a category flag to skip token strictness in latency-only tests.

jas: timeline proposals: INF-4312 draft in 4 days, INF-4313 prototype in 7 days, INF-4314 CI integration in 10 days. We should have a coordinated review in 2 weeks tied to the ops sync.

todd: schedule note: I'll include a sample wrk invocation in the INF-4313 repro:

# synthetic long-seq burst, example
wrk -t8 -c400 -d15m --latency http://stage-redwood/api/v1/generate -s scripts/long_seq.lua
# manually trigger cache pod restart on subset
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache --selector=zone!=zone-a --timeout=2m

Add monitoring hooks to collect per-host kv-miss rates.

mira: Also add a dashboard tile (Console/tests/incidents-regressions) with pass/fail, p95, and kv-miss breakdown to use during drills. Can someone own the dashboard?

kevin: I'll own the dashboard. Will plot p95, mean, error-rate, and kv-miss per host. Hook to INF-4314.

ana: PR for the prompt set will include metadata CSV with category, source file, and suggested validator.

ops-bot: Linked INF-4312 -> PM-2910; INF-4313 -> PM-2910; INF-4314 -> PM-2910

jas: can each owner add 'repro steps' and an example artifact (prompt csv, load script, mock routing file) before marking their ticket ready for review? that's the gating rule.

kevin: noted. I'll attach a sample mock-routing.json and unit tests that assert no regression when the harness toggles variants.

mira: I'll block time on the ops sync in 2 weeks for the review and accountability check. Also adding a recurring monthly mini-drill to ensure these tests run in a controlled chaos window.

todd: will post the infra PR for the load scripts today and ping reviewers.

ana: uploading prompt CSV now, PR link in INF-4312. :+1:

mira: thanks everyone. I'll update PM-2910 with links and set the follow-up reminder. We'll close the loop at the ops sync.
